news.title: Fight over cellphone leads to deadly DeKalb ghost gun shooting
news.summary: A 27-year-old man will spend the rest of his life in prison after a jury convicted him in a deadly shooting at a Decatur apartment complex, officials announced.

news.title: Man shot, killed at South Bend Park in southeast Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a fatal shooting at a park in southeast Atlanta.

news.title: Man found shot to death inside busy city park
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a fatal shooting that occurred Wednesday morning at South Bend Park.

news.title: Atlanta mother charged after nonverbal child found wandering alone
news.summary: A mother faces a charge after her nonverbal child was spotted wandering alone down a downtown street late Tuesday night, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Atlanta police recruit dies in crash on Moreland Avenue
news.summary: An Atlanta police recruit on his way to training died Tuesday morning following a motorcycle crash on Moreland Avenue.

news.title: Father granted bond after getting new trial in 2003 death of 2-month-old baby
news.summary: Danyel Smith was granted a new trial in July by a Gwinnett County judge.

news.title: Man arrested after trying to rob Atlanta Wells Fargo bank with note
news.summary: It was determined that the suspect passed a note to a bank employee demanding $25,000.
